description: FlameFinder is an SI-powered web dashboard that summarizes, ranks and interprets all 24 combustion investigations in NASA's PSI database plus 68 NTRS abstracts. For a chosen crew environment, it ranks studies, extracts 58 numbers for modelling and gives fire-safety guidance for space and Earth. Every SI item carries a script-checked verbatim NASA quote. You can ask a question in the tab, where you can ask a question and you get NASA's own sentences that best answer the question and an SI explain
